title: AuthorityRequiredProblem
description: 403 urn:amp:error:authority-required problem (WIRE-BINDING section 7.2.14): the caller needs more authority. At least one of missing_scopes, required_constraints, payment_required or human_approval is present.

AuthorityConstraint.description:
An opaque, typed constraint the caller's authority must satisfy.

Only ``type`` is interpreted by AMP; the other members are defined by
whoever owns the ``type`` (for example ``"com.acme:region"``).  Each
constraint is at most :data:`MAX_CONSTRAINT_BYTES` of JSON.

type.description: Constraint type identifier; the type's owner defines the other members
type.title: Type

AuthorityConstraint.title: AuthorityConstraint

HumanApproval.description: A human must approve at ``verification_uri`` (RFC 8628 style).

verification_uri.description: https URI where the human approves the request
verification_uri.title: Verification Uri

expires_in.description: Seconds until the approval request expires
expires_in.title: Expires In

HumanApproval.title: HumanApproval

PaymentRequirement.description: Payment the caller must make first (maps to x402 / HTTP 402).

amount.description: Amount in integer minor units of currency (e.g. cents)
amount.title: Amount

methods.description: Accepted payment methods (e.g. x402, card); empty means unspecified
methods.title: Methods

PaymentRequirement.title: PaymentRequirement

title.description: Short human-readable summary of the problem
title.title: Title

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence
detail.title: Detail

instance.description: URI identifying the specific occurrence of the problem
instance.title: Instance

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds the client should wait before retrying
retry_after_seconds.title: Retry After Seconds

max_bytes.description: 413 only: the receiver's maximum message size in bytes
max_bytes.title: Max Bytes

supported_versions.description: 406 only: protocol versions the receiver supports
supported_versions.title: Supported Versions

missing_scopes.description: OAuth scope tokens (RFC 6749 section 3.3) the caller lacks
missing_scopes.title: Missing Scopes

required_constraints.description: Typed constraints the caller's authority must satisfy
required_constraints.title: Required Constraints

payment_required.description: Payment the caller must make first

human_approval.description: Human approval the caller must obtain first

audience.description: Audience (resource or agent) the new authority must be issued for
audience.title: Audience

x-amp-constraints: human_approval.verification_uri MUST be an https URI without userinfo or fragment
each required_constraints entry is at most 4096 bytes of JSON; the whole problem at most 65536 bytes
